statement: The A2451-centered peptidyl-transferase active-site neighborhood will contain at least one exact 14-mer shared by all three original frozen pilot genomes, even though no all-three exact 16-mer from the frozen list maps there.
test: Using the exact original frozen ECOLI, PYRO, and YEAST input sequences, compute unique direct-orientation 14-mer sets independently and intersect them. The global all-three count must reproduce the previously frozen value 5,561 before target inspection. Then test whether any intersected 14-mer overlaps the fixed 51-nt E. coli 23S window centered on A2451: positions 2426-2476 inclusive. Do not widen the window or shorten k after viewing results.
support_condition: The global all-three 14-mer count reproduces 5,561 and at least one exact intersected 14-mer overlaps positions 2426-2476.
weakening_condition: The 5,561 count reproduces but no exact all-three 14-mer overlaps the fixed target window.
falsification_condition: The frozen 14-mer count cannot be reproduced from the canonical inputs, invalidating this follow-up test as implemented.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before computing the complete three-domain 14-mer intersection or inspecting any 14-mer in positions 2426-2476. The 51-nt window and k=14 are fixed here and cannot be altered retroactively.
